verdict.rationale: Datadog has an official CI-oriented CLI (datadog-ci, confirmed by probe), a documented public API reference, and CI Visibility docs, which together support headless, scripted operation in CI pipelines. The evidence is mostly page titles, though, with little detail on how the workflows actually run. Missing for 10: detailed docs on datadog-ci commands and auth in CI, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found 404s), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI use.
